summary: Reject mission run scratch directories inside Git worktrees

replay.detail: Existing run records are unchanged. Scheduled runs created before acknowledgement are recovered before new-run scratch admission.

rules.detail: New mission runs reject scratch directories inside Git worktrees, including linked worktrees and symlink aliases. Scheduled launches diagnose and fail unsafe new requests before creating directories. Inherited unsafe scratch produces a durable failed child-dispatch or loop step with a diagnostic, not a repeated reconciliation fault.

compatibility.detail: Launchers that used a repository checkout as run scratch must use a per-seat state directory instead. Declare repository checkouts separately from run scratch.

downtime.detail: No migration or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: Move affected launcher workspace declarations to per-seat state directories before their next run.

recovery.detail: Rejected launches leave the repository untouched. Correct the declaration before starting a new occurrence.
